statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic palpitations with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess for ischemic changes
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
